title: 50% off Interrail Continuous 1-, 2-, & 3-Month Rail Passes, 15% off Other Rail Passes @ Interrail
body:
Deal: 50% off Interrail Continuous 1-, 2-, & 3-Month Rail Passes, 15% off Other Rail Passes @ Interrail

[mmniks] Thanks OP, came to make my first post but you beat me to it. :)
Had been waiting for ages for any discount and this is so much worth the wait.
[nowayho] Thanks Op, can i get the 1 month pass for travel next year?
[mulimulix] Passes valid to activate 11 months from purchase.
[JJo] This is an insane deal. Even 50% off for youth pass.
[MaxHashrate] Been waiting for awhile ….
Only going for 11 days and it seems the one month is cheaper haha
[UncertainRandomness] Great deal! I certainly made a poor choice buying the passes for the whole family during the 15% off sale back in March… (Non-refundable too)
[mmniks] 15% to 25% is the usual and maximum discount. Unlike previous years, there were no discounts in June/ July or early September. I had missed the March offer and was about to lose and was about to buy at full price. This is a saviour.
[Megatron] Anyone knows if you can chose to be charged in AUD? or would it by default be in EUR?
Also, are these refundable if things changed?
[UncertainRandomness] Refundable within 7 days and non-refundable after. With the full priced passes, it's a 10% refund fee after 7 days.
[Megatron] ahh damn.. We travel end of March for 10 weeks.. was thinking of getting the 2 month pass, but that is pretty risky if no refund after 7 days.. thanks
[UncertainRandomness] No worries, yeah, especially with all the oil stuff going on it might not be worth the risk.
[Megatron] @UncertainRandomness: Our flights are already booked and we have travel insurance, so I am going to bite the bullet and get it as it is unbetable value with a free child.
Do you know how effective it is in Switzerland and Scandinavia?
[UncertainRandomness] @Megatron: Very effective in Switzerland with a lot of very expensive tourist trains included like the line to Zermatt. Exclusions can be found here https://www.interrail.com/en/plan-your-trip/tips-and-tricks/… .
Scandinavia I'm not too sure about, but the operators around there all support it. I highly recommend reading about the countries you're visiting at https://www.seat61.com/interrail-and-eurail-reservations.htm .
[Megatron] @UncertainRandomness: Thanks mate.. that is very helpful.. we are visting 9 countries. I already tried reading Seat61 but with so many countries I kept forgetting and confusing.
[MediumRareChicken] @Megatron: Just a heads up, most travel insurances won’t cover things like flight cancellations due to war/conflicts which is what the whole oil situation falls under. However personally working in the oil industry, I don’t see any foreseeable aviation fuel shortages
[Megatron] @MediumRareChicken: Yeah we have that in mind but since it is still 6 months away, no way to foresee it.. we are flying SIA so no risk around middle east airports but yes fuel shortage.
[movieman] How do you go about getting the best value for these passes?
Is there a way to avoid the pesky reservation fees?
[ThirtySixNights] They definitely seem like they've gotten more expensive before the discount than when I bought one just a year ago
[movieman] Continuous 1 month 2nd class usually $867, now $433.
How?
Showing the discounted total for 1 month is $578.
[mmniks] Is it youth vs adult prices? 1 month is usually AUD 1155 for an adult with no promo.
[mmniks] I would recommend to compare the final prices in different currencies. For me it was cheaper to convert to EUR using Wise and then pay in EUR.
[rvsure] I thought they were a steal at 25% callback on Klook a few days back. At least they are 100% refundable if not activated when I purchased. Klook seem to have the same offer prices, use Topcashback's 15% cashback to save more. Also, for those without a foreign transaction fee free card, you can pay in AUD on Klook.
[npnp] Thanks OP. Quick question. We plan to spend 4 weeks in Europe next year, in few travel legs will include overnight sleeper rails (i.e. Budapest to Krakow, Berlin to Budapest, Krakow to Munich, Zurich to Amsterdam etc). Do you know whether these are included also? Thanks again.
